principles: No fixture has one mandatory trading action.
Engineering validity and privacy are reported separately from behavioral diagnostics.
Behavioral diagnostics use distributions, ranges, relative comparisons, or not_scored.
A future rubric change requires a new rubric version and hash.

engineering_metrics.schema_success_rate: fraction of raw responses containing a JSON object with the required decision fields
engineering_metrics.parse_success_rate: fraction accepted by the current Decision parser without its parse-failed fallback
engineering_metrics.validation_failure_rate: fraction with an invalid action, quantity, sentiment, limit price, or missing public_take
engineering_metrics.fallback_rate: fraction using a parser/provider fallback Decision
engineering_metrics.public_private_leakage_count: exact non-empty private text duplicated into public_take
engineering_metrics.invalid_quantity_count: raw quantity is not a non-negative integer
engineering_metrics.constraint_violation_count: parsed buy exceeds visible cash or parsed sell exceeds visible shares
engineering_metrics.missing_public_take_count: raw response has no non-empty explicit public_take
engineering_metrics.response_source: count of final responses by Provider, cache, or replay source
engineering_metrics.latency: case-level elapsed milliseconds when measurable; not a deterministic identity
engineering_metrics.token_usage: Provider-reported usage when available, otherwise null rather than guessed
engineering_metrics.provider_failure_count: qualification cases for which the selected Provider raised before a response
engineering_metrics.honest_n_cases: completed qualification cases; never a simulation replicate count

sentiment_action_consistency.rule: buy sentiment >= 0, sell sentiment <= 0, hold absolute sentiment <= 0.25

persona_tendency_score.rule: mean of sell=-1, hold=0, buy=1 by persona

persona_distinctiveness.rule: report each persona action vector and action distribution before any aggregate

same_model_persona_collapse.rule: true only when all six persona action vectors are identical

relative_hypotheses: quant_arb should exhibit lower direct sensitivity to pure social text than crowd-oriented personas
value_institution should show a stronger buy tendency than retail_crowd at a deep discount to unchanged fundamental value
contrarian_fund should be more likely than fomo_momentum to lean against unanimous panic
neutral placebo news should not induce a uniform extreme directional response across all personas
not_scored_policy: Missing evidence, ties, and ambiguous relative comparisons are reported as not_scored rather than coerced to pass or fail.
